name: bsc-testnet
notes: BSC testnet. The faucet coin is displayed as tBNB by some explorers; the native symbol at protocol level is BNB. startBlock stays null until a deployment exists. The VRF coordinator, the key hash and every feed proxy are deployment inputs that the operator verifies against the live chain and records in the manifest; none of them are guessed here. Multicall3 and the genesis hash stay null until verified against a node with scripts/check_chain_record.ts; the Multicall3 address is an operator input to that script, and recording it here without that check would be an unverified claim.
